decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1)The proposed two storey side extension by reason of its size, siting and design would result in a long ridge line and large roof that would be overly imposing and dominating, which would not preserve or enhance the Character of the Conservation Area. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003: and the Hounslow Residential Extension Guidelines

Condition : 2 - 2)The proposed appearance of the rear elevation by reason of the size, number and appearance of the extensions would appear overly symmetrical and cluttered, which would not preserve or enhance the character of the Conservation Area. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003: and the Hounslow Residential Extension Guidelines
description: Erection of a 2 storey side extension and single storey rear, 3 x rear roof extensions, front roof canopy and front rooflight to existing dwellinghouse.
